name: exp_cronexao
summary: This EA implements a multi-timeframe Crossover strategy combining signals from higher and lower timeframes to determine trade direction. It uses moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation across different periods to generate entry and exit signals. The system includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了多周期交叉策略，结合高周期和低周期的信号来确定交易方向。它使用不同周期的均线交叉和动量确认来生成入场和出场信号。系统包含基本的风险管理功能，设有止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于多时间框架的均线交叉系统，通过高周期判断主趋势方向，低周期寻找入场时机。入场条件要求高周期和低周期的均线交叉信号方向一致，并配合动量指标确认趋势强度。出场条件包括止损、止盈触发以及反向交叉信号出现时的主动平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未实现动态仓位调整。资金管理方面设有止损和止盈参数，但缺少最大回撤控制和仓位比例管理。整体策略逻辑较为传统，依赖均线交叉的滞后性特征，在震荡行情中可能产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a multi-timeframe moving average crossover system, using higher timeframes to determine the main trend direction and lower timeframes to find entry opportunities. Entry conditions require alignment of moving average crossover signals across both higher and lower timeframes, combined with momentum indicator confirmation of trend strength. Exit conditions include stop loss and take profit triggers, as well as active position closing when a reverse crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment. Money management includes stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks maximum drawdown control and proportional position sizing. The overall strategy logic is relatively traditional, relying on the lagging nature of moving average crossovers, which may generate many false signals during ranging markets.
pros: 多周期分析有助于过滤低周期的虚假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数结构简单，便于优化和调整
设有止损和止盈，具备基本的风险控制机制
pros_en: Multi-timeframe analysis helps filter false signals from lower timeframes, improving entry quality
Strategy logic is clear and easy to understand, with simple parameter structure for easy optimization
Stop loss and take profit are set, providing basic risk control mechanisms
cons: 均线交叉信号具有滞后性，在趋势启动后才能确认，容易错过最佳入场点
固定手数仓位管理不够灵活，未根据账户资金和波动率动态调整仓位
缺乏震荡行情的过滤机制，在横盘市场中可能频繁产生虚假交易信号
cons_en: Moving average crossover signals are lagging, confirming trends only after they start, potentially missing optimal entry points
Fixed lot position sizing is inflexible, not dynamically adjusting based on account equity and volatility
Lacks a ranging market filter, which may cause frequent false trading signals in sideways markets
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率，避免无效信号
实现基于账户余额和ATR的动态仓位管理，提升资金利用效率和风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce trading frequency during ranging markets and avoid invalid signals
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance and ATR to improve capital efficiency and risk control

risk_points: 均线交叉策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损，缺乏趋势强度过滤
固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户资金变化，在连续亏损时风险敞口不变
risk_points_en: MA crossover strategy prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets, lacking trend strength filtering
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account equity changes, maintaining constant risk exposure during losing streaks
